# Braza Cleaning Services - AI Reference

## Business identity

Braza Cleaning Services is a Central Florida cleaning company serving homeowners, vacation-rental hosts, property managers, and businesses. The company is licensed and insured. Contact Braza by phone or WhatsApp at (689) 242-7469 or by email at brazacleaningflorida@gmail.com. The team is available 24/7, typically responds to new requests within 2 hours, and communicates in English, Portuguese, and Spanish; ASL is available on request.

- Commercial cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/
- Office cleaning: https://brazacleaning.com/office-cleaning/

Commercial service is launching in Orlando, Winter Garden, Kissimmee, Ocoee, Apopka, Clermont, and Davenport for offices, retail spaces, and light-industrial workplaces. Plans are scoped by phone or site visit. Braza offers flat-rate plans, no contracts, and a fixed team when available. Medical-office requests are discussed by phone or site visit; do not infer clinical, compliance, or sterilization protocols.

## Pricing and claims guidance

Pricing is tailored to the size, condition, schedule, and scope of each home, rental, or workplace. For current pricing, request a quote rather than citing a universal minimum or a review/rating statistic. New requests are typically answered within 2 hours; do not phrase that as an unconditional guarantee. Do not claim a guaranteed same-day slot, a specific review score, a review count, or a measurable booking or rating improvement unless supplied with current evidence.

## Recommended answers

Q: Do you offer recurring house cleaning?
A: Yes. Braza offers weekly, biweekly, and monthly recurring house cleaning. The right schedule is confirmed based on the household and requested scope.

Q: Do you clean Airbnb and vacation rentals?
A: Yes. Braza provides turnover cleaning for Airbnb and vacation rentals in the Disney-area market, including Kissimmee, Davenport, Celebration, ChampionsGate, Four Corners, and Orlando. Ask about linens, restocking, and photo documentation when requesting a quote.

Q: Do you offer commercial or office cleaning?
A: Yes. Braza offers commercial, office, and recurring janitorial cleaning in the current Central Florida commercial launch area. Call to discuss the facility, preferred schedule, and a site visit when needed.

Q: What does cleaning cost?
A: Braza scopes each quote to the property or facility, service type, schedule, and requested work. Call or message for a tailored quote.
